q1_issues.issue: The clause-initial frame locative "In Eskisehir" is attached only to the first build event; the distributive rule for coordinated object NPs replicates the whole predication per conjunct, so sk_build_2 should carry it too (or the parse should say why it does not).

notes: Both place PPs land as Location on one event, which is defensible if "in Eskisehir ... in Turkey" is read as place-inside-place, though the instruction set's stacked-place rule only covers directly adjacent PPs. Everything else (Patient on the created objects, no LocatedIn on hotel/mill, paper_mill genus without exposing the noun modifier, Names) follows the instruction set.
